title: Submit a limited liquor licence functions notification
summary: Limited liquor licence holders must notify NSW Police of the dates they plan to sell or supply alcohol at functions.
intro:
If you hold a limited liquor licence, you must notify NSW Police of the dates you intend to sell or supply alcohol at your functions.

You can submit your notification for one or more functions by completing a form and lodging it at your local police station. There is no fee for the notification.

You must submit the notification at least 14 days before the earliest function on the form.

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to submit the functions notification?
faqs.a: No, there is no fee for the notification.

faqs.q: How far in advance must I submit the notification?
faqs.a: You must submit the notification at least 14 days before the earliest function on the form.

faqs.q: Who do I contact with questions about liquor licensing?
faqs.a: For questions or feedback about liquor licensing, contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
